'pages' are Wikipedia articles whose Commons photographs are candidates, in order of appearance ('fr:Title' for another language); 'files' are Commons file names to use first; 'exclude' are file names to skip; 'max' the number kept; 'captions' give a caption per language to a kept file, keyed by its Commons file name.
